changed: Device Sync sends much less when nothing has changed. A sync with nothing new to share no longer re-checks every record with the sync server or re-sends this device's list of records, which also spares your other devices from downloading that list again. A device that's in use still sends it in full at least every 12 hours.

Device Sync no longer downloads again records this device already has but doesn't share: imported dances that **Skip unused imported dances** keeps back, and records you've deleted whose deletion hasn't reached your other devices yet.
data_migrations: This version's database update also remembers what this device last shared with Device Sync (schema v39). Nothing in your library changes.

added: Schema v39 also adds nullable `baseline_state.published_manifest_hash` and `baseline_state.published_verified_at`, with `SyncLocalRepository.publishedManifest` and `setPublishedManifest` (`SyncPublishedManifest`).
